name: Le Meridien St. Louis Clayton
positioning: Art-minded Le Meridien hotel in the Clayton business district of St. Louis, with a rooftop that hosts events year-round and a seasonal rooftop pool
best_for: Travelers who want a stylish base in Clayton, minutes from Forest Park and downtown St. Louis
Guests who enjoy rooftop events and an unusual dinner show

facts.text: The hotel is in the Clayton business district, minutes from Forest Park, downtown St. Louis and WashU.
The hotel celebrates art through a blend of simplicity and comfort with style and detail.
Rooms have an artistic nod to modern design.
Guest rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows overlooking downtown St. Louis - Clayton and the local area.
Beds have plush bedding, cotton-rich linens and a pillow-top mattress.
Rooms have Malin + Goetz bath amenities and personal Illy coffee and espresso.
Le Meridien Hub is a modern reinterpretation of the traditional hotel lobby.
Cafe La Vie serves French-inspired entrees, petite plates, aperitifs and handcrafted cocktails.
The 24/7 fitness center has equipment including Peloton.
The fitness center has views of the St. Louis skyline.
The hotel is moments from Forest Park, the St. Louis Zoo and the St. Louis Science Center.
The hotel is Green Key Eco-Rating Program certified.

highlights.text: The rooftop hosts events year-round for guests and locals, from wine-sipping events to winter Chalet experiences.
The hotel has a seasonal outdoor rooftop pool.
The Penthouse Suite has floor-to-ceiling windows, a living and entertainment space, a wet bar, a separate king bedroom and a deep soaking garden tub.
Suites and deluxe rooms offer extra space, luxury bedding and downtown views of Shaw Park.
Le Petit Chef blends 3D projection mapping with a multi-course dining experience led by the world's smallest chef.

considerations.text: WhataHotel notes the suburban Clayton setting means a short drive or rideshare to downtown St. Louis attractions.
